about: The Workbench icons of the Umoria drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/umoria.svg, drawn as an OS 3.5 GlowIcon: the Balrog's fire in the deep of the mines, the stair down and the player's @) is The AmiCradle Team's own, under the same terms as the other Amiga files; art/umoria.png is it rendered at 128 x 128. Umoria-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, Umoria.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's Umoria.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-Umoria, LICENSE, AUTHORS and Licences.txt; Data.info is the data and User drawers' icon.
